title: Vis, Croatia Travel Costs: 2026 Budget Guide
metaDescription: Plan your 2026 Vis, Croatia trip with this cost guide. Get concrete prices for accommodation, food, transport, and activities to budget efficiently.
content:
• Accommodation for 2026: Budget hostel beds start at €35-€60; mid-range apartments or guesthouses cost €90-€160; luxury options exceed €250 per night.
  • Daily food budget: Expect €12-€20 for a casual lunch and €30-€50 per person for a mid-range dinner. Self-catering can reduce food costs to €20-€30 daily.
  • Inter-island travel: The ferry from Split to Vis costs €8-€10 per person one-way.
  • Local transport and excursions: Scooter rentals are €40-€60 daily, though a car is usually not worth the extra cost for just Vis town and nearby beaches; Blue Cave tours are €70-€110 per person.
  • Other activities: Wine tastings or short boat trips typically range €30-€50.

faq.question: Is Vis expensive compared to other Croatian islands?
faq.answer: Vis is generally on par with or slightly more expensive than popular islands like Hvar or Korčula due to its pristine nature and less developed mass tourism infrastructure.

faq.question: Can I save money by cooking?
faq.answer: Yes, self-catering significantly reduces food costs. Local markets offer fresh produce and seafood at reasonable prices for preparing meals.

faq.question: What is the best time to visit Vis for budget travel?
faq.answer: May, early June, or September offer lower accommodation rates and fewer crowds than the peak summer months of July and August.

quickAnswer: A mid-range 2026 trip to Vis, Croatia, costs approximately €100-€180 per person per day. This includes mid-tier accommodation, two restaurant meals, and some activities. Budget travelers can aim for €60-€90 daily, while luxury experiences exceed €250. Prices are projections based on current trends.
